nuggets.text: The Broncos are reigning MAC champions, beating Miami (OH) 23-13 at Ford Field for the program's fourth league title.
In 2025 the Broncos became the first team in program history to win a conference title and a bowl game in the same season.
Head coach Lance Taylor was a walk-on wide receiver at Alabama who earned a scholarship.
Lance Taylor coached running backs at Stanford when Christian McCaffrey was a Heisman runner-up.
Kicker Dieter Kelly went 4-for-4 on field goals, including a 52-yarder, in his Bronco debut at Michigan.
The 2016 Broncos went 13-0 in the regular season and became the first MAC team to play in the Cotton Bowl.
The Broncos held the ball for 40:08 at No. 16 Michigan last week.
The Broncos came within a last-play Hail Mary of upsetting No. 16 Michigan, falling 13-12 in Ann Arbor.
The Broncos were the Hilltoppers until 1939, the year they took the Broncos name and moved into Waldo Stadium.
Lance Taylor is a member of the MOWA Band of Choctaw Indians, a state-recognized tribe in Alabama.
